## Matt Gabe

### Tenure

[2009](/wiki/2009) – [2014](/wiki/2014)
[2018](/wiki/2018) – Present

### Title

Manager, Hot Wheels Packaging Design

### Signature

[![MattGabeSig](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/8/8b/MattGabeSig.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/150?cb=20260109134731)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/8/8b/MattGabeSig.png/revision/latest?cb=20260109134731)

**Matthew Wayne Gabe** is a Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 2009 to 2014 and again since 2018. He specializes in graphic design, with his current role being a lead package designer for Mattel. Prior to working at Mattel, he worked for competing brands Hasbro and Fisher-Price, mainly also as package designer.

In addition to his own, Gabe also runs the Instagram account @hw.mighty.k, documenting his process of converting a [Honda Acty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honda_Acty) into a replica of the Hot Wheels casting [Mighty K](/wiki/Mighty_K) in honor of its designer [Ryu Asada](/wiki/Ryu_Asada) who passed away in March 2021.
